description: Compare the cached company relationship graphs of two to five stock tickers. Finds shared suppliers, customers, competitors and partners, including cross-role overlaps, using stable company entity IDs or exact tickers only. Returns directed direct relationships with VERIFIED vs SUGGESTED/NEEDS_REVIEW status, confidence, sole-source flags, disclosed metrics with meaning/unit/period, and primary-source URLs/dates. Shared groups reference the evidence-bearing relationship rows by ID. Missing graphs or edges mean unknown coverage. One cached graph read per company (plus a ticker lookup when the typed ticker has no graph); never starts paid discovery, infers exposure weights or estimates portfolio losses. Read-only.

limitPerCompany.description: Maximum direct relationships returned per input company. Shared counterparties are prioritized; totals and any truncation are reported.

roles.description: Counterparty roles from EACH subject company's point of view; default all four. Suppliers and customers preserve the direction of SUPPLIES_TO.

tickers.description: Two to five distinct Bullrun listing tickers, e.g. AAPL, BMW or 6324.T. Use the listing ticker returned by search_stocks. US/European examples: AAPL, BMW, NESN. Most Asian listings keep their exchange suffix (6324.T, 0700.HK); some use bare codes (005930). Native or suffixed forms resolve only when one listing matches; search by company name or ISIN if unsure. Company names are not accepted here.

verifiedOnly.description: Only VERIFIED edges when true. The default also includes SUGGESTED/NEEDS_REVIEW edges, explicitly labelled with their individual confidence and evidence.
